tip.help: Tutorial: shows what each part of the screen does. Also opens with F1.

tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to Team Builder!
tutorial.welcome.text: It builds teams from the Pokémon in your PC using real competitive usage stats. This tour shows one part of the screen at a time. Use Enter or the arrow keys to move on.
tutorial.slots.title: Your team
tutorial.slots.text: Six slots. Click a Pokémon to see its set in the right panel. The x (on hover) removes it. Green dot = it is in your party.
tutorial.score.title: Team score
tutorial.score.text: Higher is better. Hover to see where it comes from: strength, defense, offense, roles and synergy. With an empty team it shows up after the first Pokémon.
tutorial.buttons.title: Actions and options
tutorial.buttons.text: Apply puts the team in your party. Save keeps it for later. Party loads your current party and Clear empties it. The switches turn on 2v2, legendaries and megas.
tutorial.tabs.title: Tabs
tutorial.tabs.text: Each tab answers a question: who to add, which full teams to build, where the team is weak, how to beat a raid or a trainer, and the teams you saved.
tutorial.search.title: Search
tutorial.search.text: Type the name of a Pokémon and press Enter or + to add it. In the Trainers tab this field searches trainers.
tutorial.advisor.title: Set panel
tutorial.advisor.text: Suggested role, item, nature, EVs and moves for the selected Pokémon. The TO DO tab shows what YOUR Pokémon still needs to be ready.
tutorial.help.title: Help and achievements
tutorial.help.text: Hover almost anything for details. The ? reopens this tutorial. The ★ shows achievements: they point to your next step, up to beating gyms with the recommended team.
tutorial.suggest.title: Suggestions
tutorial.suggest.text: Left: the best from YOUR PC. Right: the best of all Cobblemon (worth catching). Click a card to add it. The green number is how much the score goes up.
tutorial.teams.title: Teams
tutorial.teams.text: Full teams built from what you already picked. Click one to use all of them at once. Scroll if there are more.
tutorial.analysis_types.title: Defense by type
tutorial.analysis_types.text: Each square is a type attacking your team. Red = many weak members. Hover to see how much each member takes.
tutorial.analysis_modes.title: Swaps and threats
tutorial.analysis_modes.text: Pick below: swaps that raise the score, meta Pokémon that threaten the team and, in 2v2, the pairs.
tutorial.raid.title: Raid
tutorial.raid.text: Near a raid crystal the boss is detected on its own. Or type the name (and tera type, e.g. "charizard fairy") and use the typed boss. The best answers show up.
tutorial.trainers.title: Trainers
tutorial.trainers.text: Pick a leader, Elite 4 or champion to see their team, who in your team answers each one and the best counters. "Build team from PC" builds the recommended team.
tutorial.saved.title: Saved
tutorial.saved.text: Teams kept with the Save button. Click to load and the x to delete. They live on your computer and work in any world.
achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.all_done: All done. You mastered Team Builder!
